scenes.en: New glasses for you... and one for Amma!
scenes.say: New glasses for you, and a free pair for Amma? Here's how.

scenes.en: Holding the newspaper far away is a sign to get her eyes tested.
scenes.say: Is Amma holding the newspaper far away to read? That's a sign to get her eyes tested.

scenes.en: Your second pair can be made to Amma's own eye power.
scenes.say: With LenzKare Fusion lenses, buy one pair of spectacles and get one free. The second pair can be for Amma, made to her own eye power.

scenes.en: Appa, kids or grandparents: choose two spectacles with Fusion lenses.
scenes.say: It works for the whole family: Appa, the kids or grandparents. Just choose two spectacles with Fusion lenses.

scenes.en: Free in store. Home test: ₹100 for the family.
scenes.say: Not sure of everyone's power? The eye test in our store is free, and our home eye test in Chennai is one hundred rupees for the whole family.
